quote: While the game looks STUNNING, it has performance and framerate drops on the PlayStation 5 Pro, and on the regular PlayStation it performs EVEN WORSE. You do not have as much freedom as you used to have in the previous games, and the characters are shallow and dull compared to the ones in GTA V. The story is simply terrible; it was written for women who read all sorts of distasteful dark romance books and appeals to their fantasy of having a man who does everything for them without getting anything in exchange. The only people I've seen appreciating this game were either white liberal women or men who pose as feminists in the hope of getting laid with them. It's Mixtape all over again.
